title: Format the Message
goal: Construct a dynamic log message with minimal memory allocations.
hints: String slice concatenation with `+` does not compile because `+` requires an owned `String` on the left.
The `format!` macro constructs the formatted output directly without extra conversions.
explanation: `format!("[{level}] {msg}")` constructs the target string directly in a single step. Direct `+` concatenation on `&str` slices fails to compile because the `+` operator requires an owned `String` as the left operand.
